pages.caption: Jesus welcomes the little children, holds them, and blesses them.
People bring young children to Jesus so that he will place his hands on them.
Jesus' followers scold the people and stop the children from coming.
Jesus sees what is happening and is very upset with his followers.
Jesus tells his followers to let the little children come and not stop them.
Jesus says God's kingdom belongs to people like these children.
Jesus says anyone who does not receive God's kingdom like a little child will not enter it.
Jesus takes the children in his arms and places his hands on them.
Jesus holds the children, places his hands on them, and blesses them.
